channel.title: Paul Bébéar
channel.description: Interactive explainers and analyses on markets, money and history.

item.title: Not-so-cosmic cycles
item.description: When do your beliefs, tastes and habits set? Not all at 25. Pick your birth year and see, with charts and sources.

item.title: SpaceX's IPO, checked
item.description: A viral video on the SpaceX listing, checked claim by claim. Most of it holds. The index mechanism it blames is described backwards.

item.title: The Premium Ladder
item.description: How many times the median full-time salary do banking, consulting and Big Tech careers pay, in seven countries, from the first job to 20 years in, before and after tax.

item.title: Labour economics study guide
item.description: 50 exam questions on labour economics: EU-LFS, labour supply and demand, wages and unemployment, with a study mode.

item.title: The Half Line
item.description: How few people hold half of all wealth or income, in 26 countries. Toggle wealth or income, remove billionaires, or count public wealth.

item.title: Capex, opex and D&A
item.description: When a cost hits profit, with live charts. One euro spent, two ways to book it, and why regulated grid operators prefer to capitalise.

item.title: The Bottom Wage
item.description: On paper, New York's minimum wage is 2.3 times Utah's. In hours of work needed to pay rent and get to work, Salt Lake City's lowest-paid workers come out ahead.
